newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Small, residual trades in techs.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Small, residual trades in techs.

text.p: Stocks were quiet in after-hours trading with a few "residual" operations being made in the technology sector, traders said on Friday.
Intel Corp was trading at its closing price of 134-5/8, while Microsoft Corp was also hovering at its close of 83-5/8.
"These are just residual trades," said one trader. "It's quiet."
The New York Stock Exchange said volume for session one was 82,000 shares against Thursday's 78,900. Session two had a volume of 4,172,003 shares against 3,995,154 the previous day, it said.
The American Stock Exchange said volume was 24,800 shares against Thursday's 1,700.
